 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Mikal Bridges repeated it eight times in a three-minute interview Friday: "Be better." The floundering shooting guard took ownership of his struggles ahead of Friday's game against the Pacers, saying he's the lone problem and solution. "I just look in the mirror, I just got to be better," Bridges said. "Nobody else to blame but me and I just got to go out there and, whatever it is, just be better and go harder."
